origine_fr: On l'écrivait d'abord avec l'autel 示 : ce qui touche aux esprits reste caché, d'où « secret ». La forme courante a remplacé l'autel par 禾. 必 donnait le son, mais il se lit bì.
origine_en: It was first written with an altar, 示: what belongs to the spirits stays hidden, hence “secret”. The common form replaced the altar with 禾. 必 gave the sound, but it is read bì.

phrase.en: She is a secretary at the company.
